test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All red are bird.

II. All bird are dog.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some bird are dog.

II. Some dog are not red.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30055fbcc409d3fe223942f85374c434d4a1469e554587bfc8707bddff367ddb.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some bird are dog. → **Follows** (As, All bird are dog)

II. Some dog are not red. → Does not follow (As, All red are bird and All bird are dog → Some dog are red)

Hence, '**Only conclusion I follows**' is the correct answer.
